We can keep your demo live while that clears. Before I make any commitments I need to confirm two things from you:

If you send those details I can escalate internally for a short-term extension and provision a limited set of test tokens so your engineers can finish the integration smoke tests.

- Extension length: 7 days from 2026-05-29
- Token top-up: 5,000 integration tokens (non-transferrable)
- Requirement: PO number (LT-44321) or confirmation of submission by procurement before we grant any further extensions
